_doc: Hồng Lô Cốc signature items (rules-proposals R7). Unpriced proposals; modifier sizes follow the fire and water catalogues' grade 3-4 items. Prefix hlo- (ho_lam is hlm-). The head also carries the catalogue's fire-furnace-mouth-gourd.

items.name: Nine-Year Ember (Cửu Niên Tẫn)

effects.name: It Does Not Cool (Bất Lãnh)
effects.rule: Your Burn stacks on a foe do not fall off when the fight pauses or the foe hides; they wait. Once a fight, when a Water hit would put out more than 5 of your Burn stacks, the ember keeps them.

items.lore: A bronze censer the size of two fists, holding one coal from the Red Furnace. Đồng Hồng Lô took the coal from the furnace mouth in 930, the winter his master died, and carried it on his belt through the nine years he kept the furnace lit (A028). He has never let it go out. He says so often. The vent warden Phòng Tẫn Thủ knows it went out once, in 1150.
items.build_use: The head's Burn engine: longer Burn on the foe, linh lực to keep feeding it, and a shield against the Water that could put it out.

items.name: Snow-Melt Gourd (Tuyết Thủy Hồ)

effects.name: Quench the Jacket (Tôi Giáp)
effects.rule: When you take Fire damage, the gourd pours: you gain 1 Water stack (once every 2 s), and while you hold 3 or more Water stacks your own Burn effects on you end twice as fast.

items.lore: A gourd of black spirit calabash, banded in copper, that fills itself with snow-melt overnight. Tần Tuyết Thán carved it in 1151 from a gourd the whale crews had carried since Kình Cốt Đường, and has poured from it into the furnace jackets every morning since.
items.build_use: Sustain for a Fire-Water alchemist who stands too close to her own fire.

items.name: Whale Road Spear (Kình Lộ Mâu)
items.lore: A harpoon of spirit-whale rib with an iron head and a line of sea-silk. It belonged to Nghiêu Phá Lãng's second, who brought the crews to Hồng Lô after 884 (V013). It has been the boat captain's since. Nghiêu Vọng Kình has had the head reforged twice and the rib never.
items.build_use: Holds a foe in place for the Whale Road Harpoon's line: accuracy and long Water debuffs.

items.name: Coal-Carrier's Ring (Đảm Thán Giới)
items.lore: A blackened iron ring the founder Tiết Thừa Hỏa put on the coal boy's finger in 772, the night he sat by her furnace until dawn and she took him as her disciple.
items.build_use: Heavier Burn and the fire's own guard.

items.name: The First Snow Jacket (Sơ Tuyết Giáp)
items.lore: The first of the snow jackets the furnace hall now wears, quilted with snow-melt water between two layers of silk; she made it for herself in 1150.
items.build_use: Healing taken and status resistance beside the furnace.

items.name: Steam Censer (Chưng Khí Lô)
items.lore: A small censer with a water jacket, in which she brews over her own Burn; the steam is the Primer's whole teaching.
items.build_use: Steam arts from Burn, and heals.

sets.name: Water Over Fire (Thủy Hỏa Ký Tế)

bonuses.effect: Ký Tế (Water Over Fire): your Burn stacks on a foe do not fall off while you are healing, and each heal you cast turns one Burn stack on each foe into a steam burst of Fire damage equal to three seconds of that Burn.

sets.story: The censer holds the fire and the gourd holds the water, and the canon says an alchemist needs both; the founder's coal ring is the hand that tends them. Đồng carries the ember and the ring, Tần carries the gourd. The valley says the next head will be whoever wears all three. Đồng has not offered the ember, and Tần has not asked for it.

sets.name: Snow Hearth (Tuyết Lô Song Bảo)

bonuses.effect: A Second Early (Tiên Nhất Khắc): your pills act a second sooner, and each time a steam art spends your own Burn stacks you heal 2 % of your health for each stack spent.

sets.story: The Snow Hearth Primer in two things: the jacket and the censer she made for the Water half of her root. She wears them beside the Snow-Melt Gourd of Water Over Fire.
